description: Promote duplicated UI chrome into lib/core/widgets/ with ZERO visual or behavior change, swapping call sites one widget at a time (create widget, swap sites, build web + test, then next). Depends on FEAT-001 (its widget/behavior tests + the existing widget_test lock the current look so a regression is caught). Covers the secondary-home HUD row, the 'All Games' back link, the inline sound toggle, the game-screen header, the trail StarRow size drift, and (carefully) the result reward rows + banners. Number Quest's richer home/header/result variants are left as-is.
steps: StarCoinHud: create lib/core/widgets/star_coin_hud.dart (StarCoinHud({required int stars, required int coins})) rendering Row[Icon(star_rounded, AppTheme.accent, size:22), Text(' $stars ', fontSize:16/w900), SizedBox(width:8), CoinPill(amount:coins)]. Swap the top-right HUD Row in the 5 secondary homes (shape_safari, word_wizard, clock_hero, memory_match, money_math), keeping the AnimatedBuilder(Listenable.merge([state, profile])) wrapper. Do NOT touch Number Quest's _Hud. Build web + test.

AllGamesBackButton: create lib/core/widgets/all_games_back_button.dart rendering GestureDetector(onTap: Navigator.maybePop, child: Row(mainAxisSize.min, [Icon(arrow_back_rounded, AppTheme.ink), Text('All Games', w800/AppTheme.ink)])). Keep the literal text 'All Games' (widget_test taps it). Swap in the 5 secondary homes. Leave NQ (Align-wrapped) as-is. Build web + test.

SoundToggleButton: create lib/core/widgets/sound_toggle_button.dart (SoundToggleButton({required bool soundOn, required VoidCallback onToggle})) rendering the exact ComicButton (label 'Sound: On'/'Sound: Off', volume_up/volume_off icon, color white, textColor AppTheme.ink, fontSize 16). Swap in the 5 secondary homes keeping the AnimatedBuilder(animation: profile) wrapper and the onToggle that flips BOTH profile.setSoundOn and state.setSoundOn. Build web + test.

GameHeader: create lib/core/widgets/game_header.dart rendering the header Row (title + TimerChip(seconds) + 'current / total' text, fontSize 18/w800, 8px gap, then ClipRRect(radius 10) + LinearProgressIndicator(minHeight 12, backgroundColor white, color=progressColor)). Choose a signature that lets each caller pass its title text/widget and progress color. Swap in the 4 game screens (safari/wizard/clock/money). Memory Match uses a 'matchedPairs / pairs' label with the same structure — adapt only if the signature supports a custom count label without regressing, else leave it and note. Do NOT touch Number Quest's richer header. Build web + test (the word_wizard_speaker_test pumps the wizard game screen and finds the volume_up icon — keep it rendering).

StarRow drift: in lib/games/number_quest/screens/level_map_screen.dart change the trail StarRow size 18 -> 17 to match the other trail/map screens. Do NOT change result-screen star sizes (44/46). Build web + test.

RewardRow + ResultBanner (RISKIEST): create lib/core/widgets/reward_row.dart (leading Widget + label fontSize17/w700 + Spacer + value fontSize20/w900) and lib/core/widgets/result_banner.dart (full width, padding v10 h8, color AppTheme.primary, radius 12, Border.all(AppTheme.ink, 2.5), white centered fontSize15/w900). Swap ONLY the byte-identical sites in safari/word_wizard/clock/money/memory result screens. Leave Number Quest's _rewardRow/_recordBanner/_levelUpBanner + XP row untouched (note as future work). Keep the 'Your time' row (ends in TimerChip) inline unless a clean generalization exists. If a site is not pixel-identical to the shared _banner, leave it inline and note it. Build web + test.

Add/extend a phone-surface widget test (test/widget_test.dart or test/core_widgets_test.dart) asserting StarCoinHud / AllGamesBackButton / SoundToggleButton / GameHeader render on a secondary home and a game screen (Size(430,1000)), and that tapping the sound toggle flips the label without throwing. Final build web + test. Record in findings which result-screen sites were promoted vs left inline.
acceptance_criteria: New widgets exist in lib/core/widgets/ (star_coin_hud, all_games_back_button, sound_toggle_button, game_header, reward_row, result_banner) and are used by the safe call sites with no visual/behavior change.
Number Quest's home, game header, and result reward/banners are unchanged; risky result-screen unifications are left inline and noted in findings rather than forced.
The trail-map StarRow size is consistent (NQ changed 18 -> 17; result sizes untouched).
`& "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" build web` prints `Built build\web` and `& "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" test` passes (original + FEAT-001 + new widget tests).
findings:
Promoted 6 core widgets with zero visual/behavior change, swapped one at a time with build web + test between each.

Step 1 StarCoinHud (lib/core/widgets/star_coin_hud.dart): swapped the top-right HUD Row in all 5 secondary homes (shape_safari, clock_hero, word_wizard, money_math, memory_match), keeping the AnimatedBuilder(Listenable.merge([state, profile])) wrapper. Removed the now-unused coin_pill import from those homes (CoinPill was only used inside the HUD). Number Quest _Hud untouched.

Step 2 AllGamesBackButton (lib/core/widgets/all_games_back_button.dart): swapped the GestureDetector back-link in all 5 secondary homes; literal 'All Games' text preserved for widget_test. NQ Align-wrapped variant left as-is.

Step 3 SoundToggleButton (lib/core/widgets/sound_toggle_button.dart): swapped the sound ComicButton in all 5 secondary homes, keeping the AnimatedBuilder(animation: profile) wrapper and the onToggle flipping BOTH profile.setSoundOn and state.setSoundOn. Removed the now-unused comic_button import from those homes (ComicButton was only the sound toggle there).

Step 4 GameHeader (lib/core/widgets/game_header.dart): signature (title, countLabel, seconds, progress, progressColor). Swapped the header Row+progress bar in all 5 game screens including Memory Match (its 'matchedPairs / pairs' label passes cleanly as countLabel, no regression). Removed the now-unused timer_chip import from those 5 game screens (NQ game_screen still uses TimerChip directly and is untouched). NQ richer header untouched.

Step 5 StarRow drift: number_quest/screens/level_map_screen.dart trail StarRow size 18 -> 17 to match the other trail/map screens. Result-screen star sizes (44/46) untouched.

Step 6 RewardRow + ResultBanner (riskiest):
- PROMOTED: The 'Coins earned' reward Row was byte-identical across all 5 non-NQ result screens (safari, clock_hero, word_wizard, money_math, memory_match) -> replaced with RewardRow (lib/core/widgets/reward_row.dart; leading widget + 10px gap + label 17/w700 + Spacer + value 20/w900).
- PROMOTED: Every per-file private _banner(String) helper was byte-identical across those same 5 result screens -> replaced all _banner('...') call sites with ResultBanner (lib/core/widgets/result_banner.dart) and deleted the 5 private helpers. Banner call sites promoted: safari (befriended, NEW FASTEST, NEW BEST), clock_hero/word_wizard/money_math (NEW FASTEST, NEW BEST), memory_match (NEW FASTEST).
- LEFT INLINE (noted): The 'Your time' row (leading Icon + 8px gap + label + Spacer + TimerChip, not a plain value Text) does not fit RewardRow's value-Text shape, so it was left inline in all 5 screens per spec. The '% / correct' summary Text block and StarRow(size:44) were left inline.
- LEFT UNTOUCHED (future work): Number Quest result_screen.dart keeps its richer _rewardRow/_recordBanner/_levelUpBanner helpers and the XP row; not unified to avoid behavior/visual change.

Step 7: Added test/core_widgets_test.dart with a phone surface (Size(430,1000)) asserting StarCoinHud / AllGamesBackButton / SoundToggleButton / GameHeader render on the Shape Safari home and game screen, and that tapping the sound toggle flips 'Sound: On' -> 'Sound: Off' without throwing.

Verification: build web prints 'Built build\web'; flutter test = 47 passed (45 prior + 2 new).
